slow.$description: Panel open, resize and tab slide (glass panel).

enter.$description: Content entering: an enter fade, a stagger chunk, an icon cross-fade.

large.$description: Large surfaces: modals, drawers and full-height panels opening or closing.

decelerate.$description: Fades out of a highlight, hover hints appearing.

out.$description: Enter and exit: a fast start that settles quickly. Also press feedback with motion.scale.press.

swap.$description: Icon cross-fades and state swaps without a motion library.

press.$description: Press feedback: a button or toggle scales to this on :active, transform only, over duration.base. Drop the scale under prefers-reduced-motion and keep the color change.

raised.$description: Floating grips, docked rails above content.

overlay.$description: Drag overlays, drop indicators, tooltips over panels.
